text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before running in the Takarazuka Kinen, 
Manhattan Cafe was about to make a fresh 
start from here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her gradual return to form was surely 
thanks to the "bonds" that had deepened 
after the incident at the airport.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon also hopes the grown 
Manhattan Cafe will reach an unknown realm 
beyond all limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's rival is Silence Suzuka. Will 
Manhattan Cafe be able to surpass her and 
the "friend" ahead of her?
